properties.description: Major rock types: Dolostone. Minor: Sandstone, Shale, Conglomerate. Regional bedrock mapping; soil and alluvium may cover the rock. Boundaries are generalized, not parcel or excavation guidance. Missouri Department of Natural Resources, Geological Survey and Resource Assessment Division, 2005, Bedrock geology, State of Missouri: Missouri Department of Natural Resources, scale 1:500,000.
